rule.formula: rbp = min(a_second, first_second); rbx = min(a_second, second_second); n = min(rbp, rbx); return_low_byte = (1 if memcmp(first_buf, second_buf, n) != 0 else 0) | (1 if rbx != rbp else 0)
rule.formula_note: the rule is stated over the low byte only: the final or eax,edx is full-width, and edx's upper bits after the memcmp call are whatever the callee left (rdx is caller-saved), so the upper bytes of the returned eax are not determined by this window's bytes alone. The callee is called with rdi = B.first.first, rsi = B.second.first, rdx = n. The first input struct contributes only its second field (a_second at A+8); its pointer is never passed to the callee.
rule.inputs: a_second (u64 at first input struct + 0x08), first_second (u64 at B.first + 0x08), second_second (u64 at B.second + 0x08), first_buf (pointer at B.first + 0x00), second_buf (pointer at B.second + 0x00), where B is the second input struct pointer (rsi at entry) and B.first/B.second are the pointers at B + 0x00 / B + 0x08
